text: On August 15, 2021, the City received an Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment application for 1799 St. Clair Avenue West to redesignate the subject lands from General Employment to Mixed Use Areas and to permit the construction of three towers with heights of 30, 40 and 45 storeys, including base buildings ranging in height from three to eight storeys, with two towers fronting onto St. Clair Avenue West and the third tower located to the south. In addition, the City received a Site Plan application, and an application for a proposed plan of subdivision, proposing the subdivision of the Site into several blocks to accommodate the proposed buildings, public and private laneways and municipal services.
